records.subject: CNT–non-ionic-surfactant thermoelectric clay

records.quote: Here, we present a thermoelectric clay made of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and non-ionic surfactants as viscous additives for use in skin-adaptable permanent power sources for the e-skin.
